title: Battle of the Imjin River
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Imjin River", at revision 1376480748, describes itself in its short description as a "Major confrontation during the Chinese Spring Offensive of the Korean War", fought 22–25 April 1951 on the Imjin River in Korea between United Nations forces — the United Kingdom, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Philippines and the Republic of Korea — and China, and records the outcome as Chinese forces pushing the UN back 25 mi (40 km) while failing to achieve a breakthrough. Wikidata item Q16170016, whose own description reads "1951 major confrontation during the Chinese Spring Offensive of the Korean War". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
